O.content: The marker aligned with "Other" is lower on the page than every other category marker.
The vertical axis is visibly labeled "Value", with tick labels increasing upward from 0 to 65.
The chart title reads "Public Service Feedback Share by Category".

B.text: If marker height on the vertical axis labeled "Value" encodes feedback share with larger values higher on the axis, then the lowest marker represents the lowest-share category; the task routes that category to low-feedback coverage follow-up.
B.conditions: Treat the plotted vertical positions as the authoritative feedback-share encoding despite their inconsistency with the nearby percentage inscriptions.
